verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only generic 'built-in observability' claims and AI Gateway request/token/cost metrics, plus event subscriptions letting Workers/KV/Workers AI events feed a queue for custom workflows — but nothing documents a dashboarding feature that lets a devops-lead combine metrics from arbitrary/any services into one custom view. Missing for 10: an analytics/dashboard API or UI (e.g., GraphQL Analytics, Grafana/Datadog integration) explicitly supporting cross-service custom dashboards, and any hands-on/community confirmation of building such dashboards.
